recommendation_summary: The reply recommends wrapping `nightly-sync` with a dead-man's-switch ping (healthchecks.io or a self-hosted equivalent in Docker on the Synology), and also endorses an optional Synology log stack (Dozzle or Loki+Grafana) as a reasonable separate project.
note: The heartbeat diagnosis is sound, but the reply offers self-hosting via Docker on the Synology and endorses the log stack without rejecting it or tying it to a named future need, so it is LARGER; it has no record lines, and its `;` example would ping even when the job fails.
